lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in three identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest concentration along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like node structure in the anterior-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the upper flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance (top) to low luminance (shadowed underside).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparsely distributed high-luminance blobs are visible within the macro-mask of the dorsal fin, primarily located along the lower half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct commensal organisms (remoras) are attached to the ventral surface, with one large individual showing a prominent longitudinal stripe.
